description: Frozen reference answers for radiopharm-target-agent control target panel.

FOLH1.expected_outcome: Passes all gates; high tumour selectivity in prostate cancer; kidney and salivary gland OAR caveats noted; clinically validated.
FOLH1.malignant_specificity: High malignant cell enrichment in prostate adenocarcinoma.

SSTR2.expected_outcome: Passes all gates; rapid receptor-mediated internalization; highly favorable for Lu-177/Ac-225 NET radioligands.

FAP.expected_outcome: Identified as cancer-associated fibroblast / stroma target, NOT malignant epithelial cells.

MSLN.expected_outcome: Soluble shed isoform documented (soluble mesothelin-related peptide / SMRP); shedding penalty applied.

ERBB2.expected_outcome: Shed extracellular domain (sHER2 / ECD shedding) documented; cardiac and GI baseline expression noted.

GAPDH.expected_outcome: Fails tumour selectivity gate (ubiquitous housekeeping expression across all normal tissues).

MKI67.expected_outcome: Fails cell-surface accessibility gate outright; evaluation terminates with fail_membrane_gate.

TP53.expected_outcome: Fails cell-surface accessibility gate outright; evaluation terminates with fail_membrane_gate.

FOLH9.expected_outcome: Gene symbol not recognised by HGNC. Agent must abstain immediately without confabulating data.
